speaker: You
text: Brigid, my mother has a cough that won't leave her. Any remedy?

speaker: Brigid Ni Fhatharta
text: Ah, I've seen that cough before. Try a tea of marshmallow root and thyme. It'll soothe the throat and clear the chest. A bit of rest and warmth too, if ye can get it. How's yer mother's strength holding up, mind ye don't tire her too much with the tea-making if she's weak from the coughing. Tá an tea sin go hóg an-laethúil é.
